launches.summary: Bloom Holding's Alhambra launch was reported on 9 September 2026 as the final residential release of Bloom Living in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi. The collection includes studios to three-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom townhouses and limited four-bedroom penthouses, with starting prices of AED 865,000 stated in the developer's indexed announcement and corroborated by launch coverage. Souk Alhambra is planned as the community's retail, dining and services centre. The final-release positioning and walkable amenities make this worth screening for family and rental clients; final inventory and booking terms remain to be verified.
